newsitem.title: UK: WEW hits record low on earnings warning.
newsitem.headline: WEW hits record low on earnings warning.

text.p: Shares in WEW Group Plc hit a record low after the discount department store operator said sales in June were below expectations and its loss for the year ending July 31 would be more than four million pounds, traders said.
By 1319 GMT, WEW traded 2-1/2p lower at 7p after touching 6-1/2p, making it the largest percentage loser. Shares are well below their year peak of 27p.
"It's been hit so hard already but it had to come off today because of that news," one trader said.
The company said it was likely the trading loss before taxation and non-trading profits and losses for the financial year will be in excess of four million pounds.
The group has realised net profits from property disposals of 400,000 pounds to set against this loss.
Eight stores are set to close by August 31 requiring a provision of 2.8 million pounds, it said.
WEW said it has appointed an adviser on options for the business, including offers for the entire issued share capital of the group. No formal offer has yet been received.
